transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling persistently down and constantly exhausted for a very long time now, actually for over two years. I decided to seek help because this low mood and tiredness just won't go away.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting two months or more when your mood felt back to normal, or has the depression been there most of the time without a break?

No, there haven't been any breaks like that. The sadness and depressed mood have been completely continuous for the entire two years and three months. I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal.

Along with feeling down, have you also had at least two of these most days for the past two years: poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low energy, low self-esteem, poor concentration, or feelings of hopelessness?

I definitely struggle with a severe loss of energy and constant physical and mental fatigue alongside the sadness. However, I haven't really noticed the other things you mentioned, like appetite changes, sleeping issues, low self-esteem, concentration problems, or hopelessness.
During the same two-year period, have there been stretches of at least two weeks when your depression got noticeably worse and you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

I'm not really sure about any specific two-week periods where things got worse or where I lost interest in things. Instead, my low mood, sadness, and fatigue have just been a constant, steady presence for the last two years and three months. It has just felt like one long, unchanging stretch.
Over these two years, have you often felt worthless or had very low self-esteem most days?

No, I haven't particularly struggled with feelings of worthlessness or low self-esteem. Instead, I just feel a constant sense of emptiness and sadness, along with a deep physical and mental exhaustion that never seems to lift.
Most days over these two years, have you had trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, I have. For the past two years and three months, I've struggled with severe mental fatigue where trying to think or concentrate wears me out very quickly. It makes it really hard to focus on anything for long.
Most days over these two years, have you also felt hopeless about the future?
No, I haven't really felt hopeless about the future. I'm not sure about that specific feeling, as it is more of a constant sense of emptiness and fatigue that I experience day-to-day.

At any point during these two years, for at least two weeks, did you have five or more depression symptoms at the same time, such as worse sleep or appetite, guilt or worthlessness, poor concentration, low energy, slowed down feeling, or thoughts of death?

No, I haven't really experienced most of those specific symptoms like changes in my sleep or appetite, feelings of guilt, or thoughts of death. My main issues have just been the constant, ongoing sadness and the low energy and fatigue over the last two years. I haven't had any periods where a bunch of those other symptoms piled on at once.
